response.original_title: マルハン presents NOAH Jr. GRAND PRIX 2 〜LETHAL ODYSSEY TOUR 2026〜
response.overview: Jr. Grand Prix 2 ~Lethal Odyssey 2026~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by Pro Wrestling NOAH, held on November 23, 2026 at Bandaijima Multipurpose Plaza "Ookama" in Niigata, Japan. It served as the seventh and penultimate show for the company's annual single-elimination tournament showcasing their junior heavyweight division, and featured both of its semi-final matches.
